registration.field_ownership: sInstance is static; mInjectClasses and mArrayMap are instance fields on the singleton helper
registration.namespace_rule: exact Class.getSimpleName(), not binary or fully-qualified name

member_rule.parameter_comparison: exact Class identity for every position

commit_semantics: clazz appends a non-null Class to the singleton pending list; it does not alter the active map
inject with an empty pending list is a no-op and preserves the active map
inject with a non-empty pending list clears the complete active map, inserts every pending class in list order, then clears the pending list
putMethod replaces the complete namespace entry at Class.getSimpleName()
two different classes with the same simple name collide; the later pending class wins
a class with zero compatible methods still installs an empty namespace map

dispatch.parse: rainbow URI host -> class simple-name namespace; slash-stripped path -> method name

webview_creation_and_client: virtual dispatch selects CommonWebFragment.getWebChromeClient() and installs CommonWebFragment$1
CommonWebFragment.initView calls super.initView(view), then initjsinterface() for that fragment/host
host_binding.default_registration: when the enclosing LoadingWebActivity is the first stack entry and method_class_names is empty: RainbowBridge.clazz(JSCommondMethod.class).inject()
host_binding.dynamic_registration: when method_class_names is non-empty: split on &, ensure JSCommondMethod fully-qualified name is included, Class.forName each name, clazz each successful Class, then inject
occurrence_requirements: the Activity resolves getFragment() to LoadingWebActivity.CommonWebFragment
CommonWebFragment.initView executes on the host instance
the candidate class reaches clazz in that execution: fixed JSCommondMethod or a successfully resolved runtime extra
the onJsPrompt client is installed on the same mWebView field created by FragmentWebLoadingBase.initView

negative_and_unknown_cases: A compatible public static method anywhere in the APK is not exposed unless its declaring Class reaches clazz and the following inject for this host execution.
A subclass inherited compatible method is not exposed because registration uses getDeclaredMethods.
A public static method with assignable but non-identical parameter classes is rejected.
A non-public or non-static exact-signature method is rejected.
An intent-provided method_class_names value is dynamic when its concrete string is unavailable; retain an unknown dynamic-class registration and do not enumerate arbitrary APK classes.
Class.forName failures are caught and skipped; they do not create a namespace.

When mActivityStacks.size() is not 1, this fragment performs no registration commit; a singleton map may still contain state from an earlier root Activity, which must not be attributed as a new registration occurrence.
Simple-name collisions replace an earlier class namespace during the same commit, so both classes must not be reported simultaneously under that namespace.

implementation_guidance.index_pattern: summarize clazz(Class) as enqueue(class token), inject() as a stateful commit, and putMethod as declared-method enumeration with exact flags/descriptor
implementation_guidance.activity_attribution: propagate the concrete CommonWebFragment returned by LoadingWebActivity.getFragment through FragmentWebLoadingBase.initView; require the clazz -> inject path and bind the installed CommonWebFragment$1 client to that same mWebView allocation
implementation_guidance.do_not_use: global class-presence or compatible-signature search as proof of registration
implementation_guidance.dynamic_policy: emit the fixed JSCommondMethod members; emit unknown registration facts for unresolved extra class names without invented endpoints
